newsitem.title: USA: Williams Cos unit Texas Gas issues debt.
newsitem.headline: Williams Cos unit Texas Gas issues debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from William Cos unit Texas Gas Transmission Corp was priced on Wednesday via lead manager Chase Securities Inc.
